messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — want to run a very small, very focused refkit challenge to drive OSS adoption + collect benchmark stories. 2 weeks, 3 bite-sized tutorials, then a short webinar/demo. goal: product signups and 50 checklist-completed refkit installs. :seedling:
sam: love this. do we mean a 'challenge' like daily prompts or a 3-step guided tutorial series?
raj: also need to confirm lead flow — HubSpot form + UTM -> marketing queue? we should map persona fields.
emily: my take: 3 tutorials (getting started, routing/batching, cost/quantization tips) + a small benchmark notebook users can run. then webinar shows live run + Q&A. CTA: "Try the Refkit & submit results". short copy variant A/B test.
luke: timeline? I can mock the repo structure and a single Docker example for the refkit CI.
maria: timeline idea: week 1 produce tutorials + repo; week 2 challenge opens, daily prompts each morning, weekend office hours, Wed webinar recap.
sam: on benchmarks — let's include a reproducible script: `python run_bench.py --model redwood-3b --seq 512 --batch 8` and a `results.json` format for users to paste into the form. makes aggregation easy.
emily: I sketched two short tweets and one long thread. sample tweet: "Try our bite-sized Refkit challenge -> ship a refapp, run a mini-benchmark, win a swag pack. Sign up: <link>"
jen: design can do a hero gif of the refapp demo + a small 3-step visual for the challenge. will need copy length limits for social.
raj: routing details: HubSpot form fields = name|email|company|region|use_case|benchmark_url|utm_campaign|challenge_code. then send to SFDC lead queue + tag as "refkit-challenge-YYMM". can we add `lead_source=community_challenge`?
maria: yes add lead_source. also want a separate nurture drip for those who submit benchmarks (3 emails: tips, community shows, webinar invite).
sam: for the benchmark aggregator I'll add a minimal GH Action that runs `run_bench.py` on push and writes results to /bench/results.json. we can auto-collect via a tiny web hook if they opt-in.
luke: repo structure suggestion: /tutorials/{1-getting-started,2-routing,3-quantize}, /bench, /webinar, /assets. README has challenge rules + prize.
emily: A/B copy idea: Version A uses product-first language (latency/cost), Version B uses community-first (learn + badges). we'll route 50/50 on CTAs.
jen: need dimensions for social cards: 1200x628 + a square for IG. I'll drop assets by EOD Friday.
maria: marketing asks: 1) canonical blog post w/ benchmark narrative + sample results, 2) challenge page + signup form, 3) 3 tutorial posts, 4) webinar registration + replay. owners? sam = tutorial tech lead, emily = copy + social, jen = design, luke = infra + repo, raj = lead routing + analytics, maria = launch owner.
sam: putting starter PR template in the repo now. includes `CONTRIBUTING.md` and `run_bench.py` example.
campaign-bot: reminder: Draft webinar page must be published to staging by 1712190000 to start early registrants.
emily: question on prizes — small swag + featured community showcase on the blog. ok?
maria: yes keep it modest. main KPI = installs + engaged leads >= 50. prize = sticker pack + shoutout.
raj: analytics: set UTM campaign `refkit_challenge_1712`. funnel dashboard: signup -> repo clone -> bench submitted -> webinar attended -> followup conversion. I'll add segments in GA + HubSpot.
sam: quick code snippet for the form embed: ```html
<form action=\"https://lp.redwood.ai/submit\" method=\"post\">\n  <input name=\"name\">\n  <input name=\"email\">\n  <input type=\"hidden\" name=\"utm_campaign\" value=\"refkit_challenge_1712\">\n  <button>Join the challenge</button>\n</form>\n```
emily: I'll draft the blog headline options: 1) "Bite-sized Refkit Challenge: Ship a Refapp in 48 hours" 2) "Measure Inference: A Mini Benchmark for Refapps"
jen: will need hero copy length: 90 chars max for the landing hero.
luke: infra note — ensure the demo runs on CPU fallback for users without GPUs. add `--cpu` flag to run_bench.py.
maria: ok owners and deadlines set. next sync Friday 10am PT to review staging page. tiny follow-ups only in this thread pls. :thumbsup:
sam: I'll PR tutorials + bench script by Thursday.
jen: design drop Fri EOD.
emily: copy drafts Thursday AM.
raj: I’ll wire HubSpot form + mapping by Thurs PM.
campaign-bot: event created: Webinar "Refkit Challenge — Live Benchmark" on 1712250000. Invite sent to: @marketing, @devrel.
